problems.problem: The declared noon key light never reads in the render: the basalt wall is a flat, evenly lit matte field with no top-light gradient, and the promised sharp horizontal shadow band along the wall base is missing. Instead a soft dark smudge hugs the left canvas edge (x 0-90, y ~560-1000) with no casting object, reading as a rendering artifact rather than intentional shade. The environment therefore looks like a flat texture behind a pasted cutout, far below the directional shadow秩序 of参考 R4.

The contact detail crop (346,997)-(1080,1247) confirms the bottle base meets the honed basalt at y=1137 with a real, correctly offset contact shadow (offset_y 0), so there is no floating. However the product's own illumination is soft frontal studio light with strong internal glow and a bright base band, while the scene claims bright noon top light; the bottle casts no directional shadow consistent with that key, so the integration reads as composited rather than photographed in situ.

At product_height_ratio 0.3799 the bottle sits at the low end of the concept's 35-74% safety band; combined with the empty upper-right quadrant (x ~430-1020, y ~100-560 is bare wall) the right column feels under-weighted against the dense three-line title block, unlike参考 R1/R8 where negative space is balanced by a stronger subject mass or tonal event.

Hierarchy inside the left column is competent but loose: the logo cap-line (y 554-578) to title top (y 648) gap is 70px while title bottom (842) to the lemon rule (929) is 87px, and the rule then floats 300px above nothing; the column lacks a closing element (subtitle/price are empty strings rendered as voids), so the文字柱 trails off instead of resolving like an instrument plaque.
